title: Open-Source Smart Contracts for AI: Facilitating Model Inference Payments on Cardano

ms.promise:
・Resource Allocation: Assign roles and responsibilities, and allocate necessary resources.
・Technology Research: Conduct in-depth research on the Cardano blockchain and existing smart contract solutions.
・Community Engagement: Initiate discussions with the open-source community for collaboration and support.
・Development Framework Setup: Establish the development environment and tools needed for smart contract creation.

In addition, we are providing a github repository including the necessary tools to reproduce our development framework setup. ms.report:
Dear Reviewer Team,
We have now open-sourced our smart contracts along with a comprehensive off-chain infrastructure in our GitHub repository: https://github.com/unboundedmarket/Smart-Contracts-for-AI
The README.md file (https://github.com/unboundedmarket/smart-contracts-for-ai/blob/main/README.md) includes sections on how to interact with the smart contracts and how to invoke the AI inference. To understand the reasoning behind our design decisions, we also refer to the report we submitted in Milestone 1: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1bd6FFdsqJKsMD0C3v35jGcJktbsrFCpw/view. We included a wide range of different off-chain scripts that build the necessary transactions to interact with our smart contracts, demonstrating the broad capabilities our model offers.
To test the smart contracts and ensure maintainability for future upgrades, we have developed a comprehensive test suite. Details on what this suite covers and how it can be used are included in our README.md under the section "Smart Contract Testing". (Test suite: https://github.com/unboundedmarket/smart-contracts-for-ai/tree/main/tests)
Moreover, to clarify the connection between the smart contracts and the AI inference, we added an additional document that explains the approach and makes it verifiable with on-chain transactions. This report can be found here: https://github.com/unboundedmarket/smart-contracts-for-ai/blob/main/CATALYST_DEMO_REPORT.md
We also asked users for feedback and released a Google Form to collect input: https://forms.gle/TvXMytFCFJoCw3Hv8. Based on this form, we created two GitHub issues (already included in our previous submission):
・"Subscription Feature Request" https://github.com/unboundedmarket/smart-contracts-for-ai/issues/2 → Addressed with this commit: https://github.com/unboundedmarket/smart-contracts-for-ai/commit/62bdfb541f53b1263fccf16a2da8c1939500613f
・"Bug in off-chain code" https://github.com/unboundedmarket/smart-contracts-for-ai/issues/1 → Addressed with this commit:

ms.report:
Dear Catalyst Reviewers,
The current version of our code is available in our open-source GitHub repository: https://github.com/unboundedmarket/smart-contracts-for-ai/. We have also added a usage guide for external users, which provides more detail than our README.md: https://github.com/unboundedmarket/smart-contracts-for-ai/blob/main/USER_GUIDE.md
We introduced our smart contracts to our community via https://x.com/unboundedmarket/status/1963224230675238983 and collected feedback from various sources. All feedback was logged as GitHub issues and addressed in separate commits. To document our process, we prepared a report that outlines our methodology and summarises the feedback received: https://github.com/unboundedmarket/smart-contracts-for-ai/blob/main/FEEDBACK_REPORT.md
Launch announcement: https://x.com/unboundedmarket/status/1969003181557309899

Dear Reviewers,
Please find the milestone outputs below:
・Catalyst Close-Out Report (PDF): https://drive.google.com/file/d/17-b1DvKaCi9FY1tSXpkk_VUiyo1q671d/view?usp=sharing
・Catalyst Close-Out Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QSToq0Ahovc&feature=youtu.be
・Uptime Report: We have also created a detailed uptime report to analyze the behavior of our smart contract infrastructure and identify different bottlenecks: https://drive.google.com/file/d/195tAscWTvTGY4gIt32nEskRy6IqusQVm/view?usp=sharing
・Final Project Documentation: User Guide https://github.com/unboundedmarket/smart-contracts-for-ai/blob/main/USER_GUIDE.md and README https://github.com/unboundedmarket/smart-contracts-for-ai/blob/main/README.md

The final codebase can be found here: https://github.com/unboundedmarket/smart-contracts-for-ai/blob/main. Throughout the project, we adjusted the codebase based on developer feedback. We have continued monitoring the repository since the last milestone but have not received any additional user feedback. All monitored changes based on current feedback are documented here: https://github.com/unboundedmarket/smart-contracts-for-ai/blob/main/FEEDBACK_REPORT.md We are also planning to continue monitoring the repository after the Catalyst project ends. 
As pointed out by one of the reviewers, we have developed a smart contract system designed for use by other projects, and all tests were performed on Preprod. In previous submissions, we have always shared Preprod transactions; however, for completeness, we have also created a mainnet transaction to demonstrate that the contract is also accessible on mainnet. https://cardanoscan.io/transaction/226e2ba0c9fba9f85fedc9e803f9a1102b6f4639ef38c5d988e70c4a758dbda6
